name: simple-builder
description: Tiny SQL builder that keeps your SQL visible. A safe sql`` tagged template plus the classic ? partials API, both returning { text, values } for pg, mysql and mysql2. Always-parameterised values, quoted identifiers, object expansion for INSERT/UPDATE/WHERE/IN. Zero dependencies, first-class TypeScript types, CJS + ESM.

scripts.test: tsc && tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2017 --lib es2017 --moduleResolution node test/types.test.ts && node --unhandled-rejections=strict test/index.test.cjs
scripts.db:up: docker run -d --name sb-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret -e POSTGRES_DB=sbtest -p 55432:5432 postgres:16-alpine && docker run -d --name sb-mysql -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=secret -e MYSQL_DATABASE=sbtest -p 53306:3306 mysql:8

author: Ondrej Machek, acrocz@gmail.com
